Turkey summoned ​Georgia's ambassador on ​Friday over violence that broke out ​at ‌a Europa ⁠League match in Batumi ‌between the Turkish Besiktas ⁠and Israeli Hapoel Beer-Sheva teams, according to a foreign ministry source. Clashes erupted after Besiktas fans unfurled a pro-Palestinian banner during the match, sparking the diplomatic row. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/520d2918-ea72-11f1-9d01-1991d4929b54/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26330794389547.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/520d2918-ea72-11f1-9d01-1991d4929b54/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26330794389547.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0ed6e17e-ea73-11f1-93c2-477b68d9ac7b</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:37:29 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/520d2918-ea72-11f1-9d01-1991d4929b54/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26330794389547.jpg">© Oto Davitadze, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Sierra Leone: Maternal deaths fall as healthcare improves, but challenges remain</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-sierra-leone-maternal-deaths-fall-as-healthcare-improves-but-challenges-remain</link><description>
Sierra Leone was once considered one of the most dangerous countries in the world to give birth. Maternal deaths have since fallen dramatically, thanks to improvements in healthcare, medical training and maternity services. But despite this progress, significant challenges remain. Activists warn that continued efforts are needed to ensure safer pregnancies and childbirth for women across the country. Clarisse Fortuné reports.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/871c7328-ea7e-11f1-9e30-f9cf020caef6/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261126-215450-215647-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/871c7328-ea7e-11f1-9e30-f9cf020caef6/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261126-215450-215647-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8c055b2a-ea7e-11f1-9f37-05dd9809ed9b</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:37:04 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>France: Macron lashes out at Le Pen’s ‘arrogance’</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-france-macron-lashes-out-at-le-pen-s-arrogance</link><description>
🇫🇷 French President Emmanuel #Macron on Thursday responded to far-right leader and 2027 presidential candidate Marine #LePen’s claim that he was “blocking” the French people’s freedom of expression.
 
Listen in to what he had to say.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/622c0d2e-ea80-11f1-9caa-77d069279b82/w:1024/p:16x9/Thumb-01-Macron.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/622c0d2e-ea80-11f1-9caa-77d069279b82/w:1024/p:16x9/Thumb-01-Macron.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c80fbb1a-ea7e-11f1-91ff-d3dc4c3d5c38</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:35:11 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>DR Congo: Copper reserves put Africa at the centre of the global race for critical minerals</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-dr-congo-copper-reserves-put-africa-at-the-centre-of-the-global-race-for-critical-minerals</link><description>
Africa is emerging as a key player in the global race for copper, accounting for around 10 per cent of the world's estimated reserves. The Democratic Republic of Congo is at the centre of this growing interest, having mined 3.4 million metric tons of copper in 2025. Its vast mineral resources are attracting growing attention from countries and companies around the world, as demand for the metal rises due to its importance in energy infrastructure, electric vehicles and the global transition to cleaner energy.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/621011c0-ea7e-11f1-99ff-1991d4929b54/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261126-214959-215155-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/621011c0-ea7e-11f1-99ff-1991d4929b54/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261126-214959-215155-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">67777a54-ea7e-11f1-a015-214c0a260739</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:30:37 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

On Nov. 27, 1885, an astronomer made the first known photograph of a meteor.

The picture was taken by Austro-Hungarian astronomer Ladislaus Weinek. He captured the trail of the meteor on a photographic plate in the Czech Republic.

The meteor he captured was part of the Andromedid meteor shower. The Andromedids were associated with Biela's Comet, which broke apart in the 1850s.

When Weinek observed the meteor shower in 1885, it was in the middle of a meteor storm. This means that there were way more meteors than usual. Skywatchers could see thousands of meteors per hour.

Why it mattered

Not many stargazers may be be acquainted with the Andromedid meteor shower. What used to be a spectacular annual meteor shower is now hardly even visible.

But in 1885, the Andromedids were an annual treat for skywatchers hoping for a chance to see the remains of Biela's comet (a comet first spotted in 1772 and then found - for the third time - in 1826 by the German astronomer Wilhelm von Biela, from whom it gets its name).

  • Meteor Shower Quiz: How Well Do You Know 'Shooting Stars'?

Camera technology has come a long way since 1885, which is good since it is a bit harder to see the Andromedids these days. Instead of photographic plates or digital cameras, astronomers now have to use special tracking equipment to record images of Andromedid meteors.

In 2011, astronomers announced that the meteor shower seemed to be undergoing a resurgence of activity, with 50 meteors per hour, and upticks were expected in 2018 and 2023.

Even if the website isn't an imitation, it's important to be wary of sites that pop up offering massive discounts. ]]> <![CDATA[ 'Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home' at 40: 'Trek' has never been as joyous or fun as in 'the one with the whales' ]]> It may have been subtitled "The Voyage Home", but to most viewers "Star Trek IV" (which has just turned 40) will always be "the one with the whales".

After "The Wrath of Khan" and "The Search for Spock" went to some pretty dark places — ear worms, the destruction of the Enterprise, the death (and later resurrection) of a certain beloved Vulcan — the franchise was in need of some light relief. So what better than to set coordinates for the then-present day of 1986 San Francisco, for a time-travel comedy romp?

Spock himself, Leonard Nimoy, had directed "The Search for Spock" and Paramount had lined him up to call the shots on a follow-up before the movie had even landed in theaters.

They gave him freedom to tell the story he wanted to tell, and he landed on a not obviously box-office-friendly formula of "No dying, no fighting, no shooting, no photon torpedoes, no phaser blasts, no stereotypical bad guy". It was a massive shift away from Khan and Kruge, the grandstanding villains in movies II and III.

Nimoy also wanted the film to have an environmental message and appeal beyond the franchise's traditional fanbase. The film would actually be promoted with minimal "Trek" branding in some territories.

"I wanted to make it accessible to people who don't go to 'Star Trek' movies," Nimoy said in "The Fifty-Year Mission" by Edward Gross and Mark A. Altman. "I wanted to make it a movie-movie. It starts out like a 'Star Trek' movie and then makes a left turn. It is intentionally very different."

"The Voyage Home" effectively closes the trilogy that began four years earlier with "The Wrath of Khan". The story picks up three months after Spock's regenerated body is reunited with his katra (spirit), though nobody ever explains why Kirk and the rest of the crew are all still wearing exactly the same clothes. Following the self-destruction of Enterprise over the Genesis Planet, the gang are heading back to Earth to face the music for a lengthy rap sheet that includes grand theft starship and insubordination on an epic scale.

But as they voyage home (geddit?) in a reconditioned Klingon Bird-of-Prey nicknamed the Bounty — complete with a cloaking device that will come in very handy when hiding in Golden Gate Park — they learn that an alien probe of unknown origin (one of the coolest "Star Trek" spaceships) is tearing Earth apart looking for humpback whales. With the species extinct since the 21st century, the crew travel back in time via one of the most surreal sequences in "Star Trek" history — Morphing CG heads? What the hell was Nimoy thinking? — in the hope of finding the whales that might just be able to ask politely if the probe might leave us alone.

Screenwriters Steve Meerson and Peter Krikes were assigned to the project early on (working with Nimoy and producer Harve Bennett on the story), and their treatments included a future Earth under threat from a plague and a discarded subplot about Lt. Saavik being pregnant with Spock's child as a result of the pon farr mating ritual. There were also discussions about the Bird-of-Prey decloaking above the Super Bowl, and — most bizarrely of all — a guest-starring role for Eddie Murphy as an astrophysicist who wants to believe in aliens.

Murphy was both a Trekkie and one of the biggest stars on the planet at the time but ultimately decided to make notorious stinker "The Golden Child" instead. "In retrospect, I think I might have been better off doing 'Star Trek IV'," he said later. Paramount had also gotten cold feet about putting the star of the highly lucrative "Beverly Hills Cop" in its highest-profile franchise.

"Paramount said, 'We're not going to put out [our] two most valuable assets in one movie – so start over, folks!'" said Nicholas Meyer (h/t The Telegraph), hired to retool the script after Murphy's departure. "That's why I was called at the last minute."

Meyer was already "Star Trek" royalty, having brought the movie series to life as director and uncredited writer of "The Wrath of Khan". Indeed, he's arguably the reason the "odd numbers bad/even numbers good" theory of "Trek" films persisted for so long, having later gone on to co-write and direct "Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country".

He shared scripting duties with Bennett, with the producer writing the 23rd-century-set bookends of the film, and Meyer handling everything in present-day California. Weirdly, Meyer had prior experience bringing a time traveler to contemporary San Francisco in his 1979 HG Wells/Jack the Ripper adventure "Time After Time".

With the three previous "Star Trek" movies largely studio-based, "The Voyage Home" marked a rare chance for cast and crew to head out on location. The Monterey Bay Aquarium filled in for the Cetacean Institute (slightly implausible home of humpbacks George and Gracie), while the USS Ranger — moored in San Diego and no stranger to Hollywood after "Top Gun" — guest-starred as a nuclear "wessel".

Kirk and co. also headed out onto the streets of San Francisco. Nimoy had toyed with giving them '80s-appropriate disguises, but changed his mind when he realized nobody would bat an eyelid at their 23rd-century civilian attire.

Aside from some second unit work photographing humpbacks off the coast of Hawaii, the whales themselves were mostly animatronics created by Industrial Light & Magic. "One of the reasons we think that ['The Voyage Home'] really didn't win visual-effects awards is people didn't really understand how good [the whales were]," said executive producer Ralph Winter. "ILM did such a good job on those whales that they went on tour for a year or more around the world to museums because the expertise, the art, and science of what they had done was very good."

Meyer, meanwhile, fully embraced the opportunity to write a fish-out-of-water comedy, with this seasoned crew of Starfleet veterans struggling to get their heads around the eccentricities of late 20th-century America.

Kirk and Spock experiment extensively with "colorful metaphors" — "double dumbass on you!" — while Kirk gets out of paying for dinner by using the convenient excuse that money isn't a thing in the future. Scotty (James Doohan) attempts to talk to a mid-'80s Apple Macintosh via a mouse before he risks screwing with the timeline by 'inventing' transparent aluminum decades early.

And in the film's most famous moment, Spock delivers a Vulcan neck pinch to a punk playing his music very loudly on a public bus, winning extensive applause from his fellow passengers in the process. The nuisance rocker was played by Nimoy's assistant, Kirk Thatcher, who co-wrote the "I Hate You" song that plays on that era-authentic ghetto blaster. He later returned to the role in "Star Trek: Picard", though this time he responded more apologetically to Seven of Nine's request to turn it down.

Kirk is undoubtedly the center of the movie, pulling the strings and getting his first romantic interest since the Original Series — whale expert Dr Gillian Taylor (Catherine Hicks), who eventually accompanies the Enterprisers back to the future. But "The Voyage Home" also gives the supporting bridge crew — all of whom reveal a talent for comedy — more satisfying character beats than they'd ever had before. Walter Koenig's W-heavy pronunciation of "vessels" would later be adopted by Anton Yelchin when he inherited the role in JJ Abrams' "Star Trek".

The crew eventually makes it out of the 20th century alive, with the whales safely secured in a giant fish tank so they can make contact with the probe. Of course, what George and Gracie actually say when they arrive in the future remains a mystery; despite Bennett's insistence that the whale song conversation should be subtitled, he was wisely overruled by Nimoy.

With Earth saved from death by giant cigar, the Enterprise crew have all their charges revoked, bar one, as Kirk is 'busted' down to Captain. The crew is then gifted the shiny new USS Enterprise-A, freeing them to continue exploring the cosmos on the big screen.

Which they did, with Shatner taking advantage of a so-called "favored nations" clause in his contract — which meant Paramount had to match anything offered to Nimoy — to direct the rather less positively received "Star Trek V: The Final Frontier", before Meyer returned for "The Undiscovered Country".

Nimoy delivered on his promise to appeal beyond the traditional fanbase, and his reward for earning "Star Trek"'s biggest ever box office haul — a record "The Voyage Home" would hold until Abrams went Trekkin' in 2009 — was directing smash-hit comedy "Three Men and a Baby" the following year. The film also paved the way for "The Next Generation", as Paramount realized the franchise's massive potential, but decided they wanted to cash in without paying mega-bucks for the legacy cast.

Hardcore fans will often claim they prefer the more serious themes of "The Wrath of Khan", "First Contact" or even "The Motion Picture" to "The Voyage Home", but "Star Trek" has rarely been as joyous or fun as on this madcap jaunt to the 20th century. "The One with the Whales" really is one for the ages.

Which they did, with Shatner taking advantage of a so-called "favored nations" clause in his contract — which meant Paramount had to match anything offered to Nimoy — to direct the rather less positively received "Star Trek V: The Final Frontier", before Meyer returned for "The Undiscovered Country".

Nimoy delivered on his promise to appeal beyond the traditional fanbase, and his reward for earning "Star Trek"'s biggest ever box office haul — a record "The Voyage Home" would hold until Abrams went Trekkin' in 2009 — was directing smash-hit comedy "Three Men and a Baby" the following year. The film also paved the way for "The Next Generation", as Paramount realized the franchise's massive potential, but decided they wanted to cash in without paying mega-bucks for the legacy cast.

Hardcore fans will often claim they prefer the more serious themes of "The Wrath of Khan", "First Contact" or even "The Motion Picture" to "The Voyage Home", but "Star Trek" has rarely been as joyous or fun as on this madcap jaunt to the 20th century. Venus will reach peak brightness during its current morning apparition at 1:37 p.m. EST (1837 GMT) on Nov. 27 according to the astronomy website In-The-Sky. Stargazers in the U.S. could get an incredible view of Venus in the predawn hours of the coming week, as the planet climbs into the southeastern sky ahead of the rising sun, with Mercury clinging close to the horizon below.

Celestron Nexstar 4SE

This is a fantastic go-to telescope with a 4-inch aperture and can help you quickly find a steady view of the moon. For a closer look at craters and the terminator, make sure to grab a 9mm or 12mm eyepiece and get stronger magnification.

_

Celestron Nexstar 4SE review

The bright star Spica will glow less than five degrees away from Venus before dawn on Nov. 27 — roughly the width of your three middle fingers held at arm's length against the night sky.

Spica is a double system of two stars that orbit one another once every four days. Its stars are separated by just approximately 11 million miles (less than 18 million kilometers), making them far too close to split visually with even the most powerful amateur equipment. However, the system still makes for a dazzling target, appearing as a magnificent blue-white star when viewed through the eyepiece of a 4-inch telescope.

Check that the sun is safely below the horizon before turning your telescope on Venus to observe a crescent of light playing across the planet's dense atmosphere. Over the coming weeks and months, Venus will appear increasingly illuminated as it moves farther away from Earth in its orbit, while its apparent size through a telescope will gradually decrease.

  <item>
   <title>Ben Thabetová: Lidé, kteří o nás rozhodují, nám možná nepřijdou ani na pohřeb</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/o-zivote-zblizka/ben-thabetova-lide-kteri-o-nas-rozhoduji-nam-mozna-neprijdou-ani-na-pohreb/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=o-zivote-zblizka</link>
   <description>Od dětství slýchala, že z ní nic nebude. Před téměř třiceti lety vzala malou dceru, nastoupila do autobusu a odjela do zahraničí. Za sebou nechala život, který jí druzí předpovídali, i přesvědčení, že musí naplňovat jejich očekávání. Dnes žije spisovatelka, numeroložka a koučka Monika Ben Thabetová mezi Itálií a Španělskem a říká, že už nepotřebuje nikomu nic dokazovat. V podcastu O životě zblízka ale přiznává i to, jak dlouho jí trvalo přestat se bát samoty a naučit se ve vztazích neztrácet samu sebe.</description>

  <item>
   <title>V noci zmizel jeden muž, pak další. Před 140 lety napadl loď obří mořský had</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/historie/historie-obri-morsky-had-lod-niobe-zahada-1886/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=historie</link>
   <description>Před 140 lety, v sobotu 27. listopadu 1886, vyšel v příloze australských novin The Hamilton Spectator článek o podivném konci posádky velrybářské lodi Niobe, lovící v jižním Tichém oceánu. Loď potopil rozzuřený velrybí samec a na rybáře, kteří se stačili nalodit do záchranných člunů, začala během následujících nocí útočit tajemná nestvůra, popsaná přeživším členem posádky jako třiadvacetimetrový mořský had. Zvláštní přitom bylo, že podobná pozorování obřích mořských hadů se ten rok objevila na více místech. Šlo o sdílenou legendu? Nebo mohly mít tyto zprávy reálný základ?</description>

      <description>Vydatné sněžení nezasáhlo pouze Česko. Objevilo se rovněž například v sousedním Rakousku, a to včetně Vídně. V hlavním městě naměřili celkem 18 centimetrů sněhu, z toho 15 centimetrů napadlo za jediný den. To je nejvyšší hodnota v listopadu od roku 1995. </description>

    <item>
      <title>Za nehodou vlaku se 44 zraněnými ve Francii byl mladík s psychickou poruchou</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/francie-normandie-vykolejeni-vlaku-kradez-kolejnice.A261127_165018_zahranicni_aya#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Francouzské úřady vyšetřují přibližně dvacetiletého mladíka kvůli zářijovému vykolejení vlaku v Normandii, při němž utrpělo zranění 44 lidí.  <description>Jednání lídrů Evropské unie o rozpočtu na roky 2028 až 2034 narušil odchod několika zemí, které požadují větší škrty. Čtvrteční summit v Bruselu neměl přinést konečnou dohodu, ale ani nepřiblížil obě strany sporu tak, jak předseda Evropské rady António Costa doufal. Další pokus o kompromis čeká lídry 17. prosince.  <title>ONLINE: Starlink na Ukrajině znovu funguje dobře. Na okupovaném území je situace horší, řekl Zelenskyj</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-starlink-na-ukrajine-znovu-funguje-dobre-na-okupovanem-uzemi-je-situace_2611270630_mst</link>
 <description>Satelitní komunikační služba Starlink americké společnosti SpaceX a její vojenská verze Starshield nad částmi Ukrajiny ovládanými vládou v Kyjevě funguje dobře, na Ruskem okupovaných územích s omezeními. V rozhovoru s britskou BBC to řekl ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj. Fungování systému „se vrátilo k normálu na tom území Ukrajiny, které kontrolujeme. Ale teď máme omezení na dočasně okupovaném území,“ popsal Zelenskyj. </description>

<item>
 <title>Merz: Lídři EU se na summitu k rozpočtu sejdou kolem půlnoci. Pak ho ukončí</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/merz-lidri-eu-se-na-summitu-k-rozpoctu-sejdou-kolem-pulnoci-pak-ho-ukonci_2611262240_vsn</link>
 <description>Lídři členských zemí Evropské unie, kteří se účastní summitu v Bruselu, se sejdou znovu kolem půlnoci a pak jednání věnovaná příštímu dlouholetému rozpočtu sedmadvacítky ukončí. Ve čtvrtek večer to podle agentury Reuters oznámil německý kancléř Friedrich Merz. Dohodu o unijním rozpočtu se ale podle něj šéfové států a vlád pokusí najít ještě letos na dalším summitu, který začne 17. prosince.</description>

Z nesourodých součástek tvořili zlepšováky pro běžný život. První místo v soutěži nakonec vybojoval tým ze ZŠ a MŠ Kamenický Šenov s výrobkem Thermo Tray.</description></item><item><title>Skláři z Libereckého kraje rozzářili Prahu. V Troji udivuje Křišťálová zahrada</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906909-sklari-z-libereckeho-kraje-rozzarili-prahu-v-troji-udivuje-kristalova-zahrada.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906909-sklari-z-libereckeho-kraje-rozzarili-prahu-v-troji-udivuje-kristalova-zahrada.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Mistrovství sklářů z Křišťálového údolí z Libereckého kraje opět okouzluje hlavní město. V pražské botanické zahradě začal třetí ročník magické výstavy Křišťálová zahrada, kde až do poloviny února vyniknou dechberoucí skleněné květy a světelné instalace ze sklářského regionu.</description></item><item><title>Všechno začalo jednou prohlídkou. Muž bez domova teď daroval muzeu svůj poklad</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906863-vsechno-zacalo-jednou-prohlidkou-muz-bez-domova-ted-daroval-muzeu-svuj-poklad.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906863-vsechno-zacalo-jednou-prohlidkou-muz-bez-domova-ted-daroval-muzeu-svuj-poklad.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:45:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Stačila jediná návštěva Automoto Musea v Lučanech, aby se zrodil silný lidský příběh. Klient liberecké Naděje, která pomáhá lidem bez domova, a celoživotní fanoušek motorismu po ní muzejníkům věnoval dvě krabice dobových časopisů a unikátních fotek ze závodů. Svůj poklad střežil 40 let.</description></item><item><title>Incident na dívčím volejbale. Liberecký trenér hodil soupeřce balón do obličeje</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/micove-sporty/906881-incident-na-divcim-volejbale-liberecky-trener-hodil-souperce-balon-do-obliceje.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/micove-sporty/906881-incident-na-divcim-volejbale-liberecky-trener-hodil-souperce-balon-do-obliceje.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:21:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Míčové sporty</category><description>Utkání volejbalové extraligy dívek do osmnácti let mezi libereckou Duklou a Lokomotivou Plzeň přineslo incident. Domácí trenér Josef Smolka hodil po hostujících hráčkách balón a jednu z nich zasáhl do obličeje. Incident řeší disciplinárka volejbalového svazu.</description></item><item><title>Zimní počasí pokračuje, víkend přinese slunečno</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906872-zimni-pocasi-pokracuje-vikend-prinese-slunecno.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906872-zimni-pocasi-pokracuje-vikend-prinese-slunecno.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:43:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vydatné sněžení se Libereckému kraji vyhnulo, nasněžilo jen lehce. Zima ale bude pokračovat i v dalších dnech. Už to ale bude beze sněhových srážek, ale s nízkými teplotami, které budou pod nulou nebo jen lehce nad ní.</description></item><item><title>Adventní Drážďany bez stresu a přestupů. Z Liberce opět vyjede Vánoční kometa</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/906862-adventni-drazdany-bez-stresu-a-prestupu-z-liberce-opet-vyjede-vanocni-kometa.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/906862-adventni-drazdany-bez-stresu-a-prestupu-z-liberce-opet-vyjede-vanocni-kometa.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 27 Nov 2026 06:27:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Oblíbený přímý vlak Vánoční kometa spojí opět během adventních sobot Liberec s drážďanskými vánočními trhy. Dopravce Trilex nasadí posílené soupravy i na vybrané pravidelné víkendové spoje a cestující mohou využít zvýhodněnou skupinovou jízdenku s bezplatnou přepravou dětí.</description></item><item><title>Jablonec porazil 2:0 lídra tabulky Lugano a v Konferenční lize má první výhru</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/906859-jablonec-porazil-2-0-lidra-tabulky-lugano-a-v-konferencni-lize-ma-prvni-vyhru.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/906859-jablonec-porazil-2-0-lidra-tabulky-lugano-a-v-konferencni-lize-ma-prvni-vyhru.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:48:17 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Fotbal</category><description>Fotbalisté Jablonce ve 4. kole Konferenční ligy porazili doma 2:0 dosavadního lídra soutěže Lugano a zaznamenali premiérové vítězství v hlavní fázi. V 70. minutě otevřel skóre obránce Martin Cedidla a pojistku přidal o čtvrt hodiny později útočník Lamin Jawo.</description></item><item><title>Zmrzlý a bezmocný. Hasiči zachránili z komína uvězněného puštíka</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906857-maly-zmrzly-a-bezmocny-hasici-zachranili-z-komina-uvezneneho-pustika.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906857-maly-zmrzly-a-bezmocny-hasici-zachranili-z-komina-uvezneneho-pustika.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:02:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Netradiční záchranu zvířete mají za sebou hasiči v Desné. V komíně tamního domu uvízl zesláblý puštík, který se nedokázal sám dostat ven. Díky spolupráci profesionálních i dobrovolných jednotek se opeřence podařilo bezpečně vyprostit a předat do péče odborníků.</description></item><item><title>Podvodníci zneužívají vánoční shon. Jak se nenechat napálit u dobírky?</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906765-podvodnici-zneuzivaji-vanocni-shon-jak-se-nenechat-napalit-u-dobirky.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906765-podvodnici-zneuzivaji-vanocni-shon-jak-se-nenechat-napalit-u-dobirky.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 18:33:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Před Vánocemi roste počet nákupů na internetu, čehož využívají podvodníci. Zákazníci v předvánočním shonu snadno zaplatí za nechtěný balík na dobírku s bezcenným obsahem. Získat peníze zpět je přitom velmi obtížné, upozorňuje spotřebitelská organizace dTest a radí, jak se nenechat nachytat.</description></item><item><title>Češi se bojí mluvit anglicky. Kvůli jazyku se vzdávají i pracovních šancí</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906746-cesi-se-boji-mluvit-anglicky-kvuli-jazyku-se-vzdavaji-i-pracovnich-sanci.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/906746-cesi-se-boji-mluvit-anglicky-kvuli-jazyku-se-vzdavaji-i-pracovnich-sanci.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 16:51:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Hanka Poskočilová</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Česká republika si v mezinárodním žebříčku znalostí angličtiny pohoršila a nově jí patří 24. místo ze 117 zemí a regionů. Ještě větší problém než samotné znalosti ale představuje strach z mluvení, kvůli kterému Češi přicházejí o pracovní i osobní příležitosti.</description></item></channel></rss>
